# Tenzi

> Tenzi (Tenzi Pty Ltd) builds workflow automation software for Australian general insurance brokers. It takes the slow, manual parts of new business, renewals, and claims off a broker's desk so the same broker, in the same hours, can write more and serve clients better. Seed funded, based in Melbourne, currently building with a design partner cohort. Patent pending (form-filling automation).

Key facts:

- Audience: Australian general insurance (GI) brokers: Authorised Representatives (ARs) under AFSL networks, brokerages holding their own AFSL, and licensee groups
- Stage: seed funded; the pre-renewal engine is in use with the first design partner cohort (four broker teams since April 2026; the first pre-renewals built in Tenzi went to real clients in August 2026). New business form filling is next; claims is in design with partners
- Design partner program: three months (map how the broker does renewals, send real pre-renewals through Tenzi from the broker's own Outlook, measure hours and dollars), about one hour a week of the broker's time. Cohort 02 is now open: six seats, seats start as they fill, $100 a month for the three months; after that a monthly price per broker, no lock-in, agreed in month three against the hours saved (figure not yet set, positioned as a fraction of an admin hire). Brokers under a licensee need their licensee's yes; Tenzi provides a governance summary
- Co-founder: Roshan Khozouei, previously General Manager of Data Labs at Australia Post and a Scaling AI Industry think tank leader at CSIRO's National AI Centre
- Entity: Tenzi Pty Ltd, ABN 41 690 320 846, Melbourne, Australia
- Contact: roshan@tenzi.ai
